decisions.reason: The waterproof lined range is close to the firm's core safety footwear and was publicly promoted as part of its innovation-led direction, so management stays committed to its development and tooling investment, and any weak results can be blamed on the temporary pandemic slowdown.

The ESD occupational shoe serves a lasting industrial need, fits the firm's specialization, and was publicly launched as a technology offering, so management has strong reasons to continue rather than write off the investment.

The safety shoe series is a visible part of the core range and the firm's announced design and comfort strategy, so dropping it would expose the launch decision, though series in footwear are refreshed regularly and could be replaced by a successor.
